subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

STRENUOUS
solution:
The correct answer is '**Difficult**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Strenuous**' is '**Difficult**'.
 
• **Strenuous**: needing or using a lot of effort or energy. (प्रयत्‍न साध्य या श्रमसाध्य)
 
 
• *Example: Avoid all **strenuous** exercise until the sprain heals.*
 
 
 
• **Difficult**: not easy to do or understand. [(कार्य आदि) कठिन, मुश्किल]
 
 
• *Example: a **difficult** test/problem...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Difficult.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Easy**: not difficult. (आसान, सरल)
 
• **Feeble**: with no energy or power; weak. (शक्तिहीन; दुर्बल, कमज़ोर)
 
• **Light**: the energy from the sun, a lamp, etc. that allows you to see things. (प्रकाश, रोशनी)

The erroneous part is '**their**'.
